He bitches about the US-government mandated shit because it makes him spend more time doing useless paperwork than ever. He spends one night a week at school until at least 11pm (remember school gets out around 2:30) so he can do all the government paperwork and then get caught up on grading.

On the other hand, his school has been able to play politics between the federal and state governments. If one says "You must do XYZ or no funding for whatever" they can sometimes find similar grants from the other and most times it also lets them set more of their own curriculum. This is more common with the upper-grade classes and especially the Engineering stuff.

Imo standardized tests get a bad rap. Dumb fucks do bad on them, and smart kids figure out how to do well- even if the content is fucked.

Not too bad of a filtering mechanism if you ask me.
